theme: host resource gate UPTIME MEM DF warmup ram disk admit

weaknesses.title: MEM/DF report kB; HUMANSIZE expects bytes — silent scale trap
weaknesses.detail: Agents stamp HUMANSIZE MEM_AVAIL_N without *1024 and under-report ~1024×. Board multiplies to bytes; easy to forget.

weaknesses.title: HUMANSIZE floor loses precision on inventory stamps
weaknesses.detail: ~13GB avail labels as 12G. Operators mis-read free space.

weaknesses.title: DF on missing path soft-fails; no partial parent walk
weaknesses.detail: DF /no/such → OK=0. Cannot get free space of nearest existing ancestor without agent loop.

weaknesses.title: MEM avail vs free dual without guidance
weaknesses.detail: MEM_AVAIL_N vs MEM_FREE_N; LAST is avail. Agents may gate on free and thrash under cache pressure.

weaknesses.title: SYS CAT LAST LAST glues same value twice
weaknesses.detail: Stamp path used CAT LAST LAST after STR and doubled uptime until fixed. No strcat of distinct planes without LET val shuttle.
weaknesses.repro: SYS STR n; SYS CAT LAST LAST

weaknesses.title: UPTIME integer seconds only; no boot-id / reboot detect
weaknesses.detail: Cannot tell reboot vs long up without external boot_id plate.
weaknesses.repro: UPTIME only monotonic secs since boot

workarounds: Always *1024 before HUMANSIZE on MEM/DF kB
Gate on MEM_AVAIL_N not FREE for Linux backpressure
LET val shuttle for multi-part CAT stamps
DF only existing paths; MKDIR first
language_gaps: HUMANSIZE of kB-aware helper or unit arg
MEM free vs avail doc in help
issues_faced: stamp CAT LAST LAST doubled uptime (fixed in board)
selftest 241/241; no language fix this iter
